final_message:
I added the three views to `notebooks/explore.py`, as you asked. Each one has a hypothesis cell before it and a facts cell after it. `marimo check` passes, and the whole notebook runs without errors in an HTML export.

The hypothesis cells are in my own words, since you didn't state hunches. Edit them if they don't match what you had in mind.

1. **`shipments_per_month`** is a line chart of monthly counts for Jan 2023 – Dec 2024 (1,199 shipments). Q2 averages 45.7 shipments a month, against 51.4 for the other 18 months. Most of that gap comes from 2024: Q2 2023 was 54, 55, 50, while Q2 2024 was 35, 41, 39.
2. **`q2_dip_by_port`** is a bar chart comparing each port's Q2 shipments per month with its rate in the other months, pooling both years. Seven of 10 ports drop in Q2. Ivelholm (−43%), Fennick (−35%) and Brackwater (−29%) drop the most. Cindervale (+23%), Aldermouth (+13%) and Glassford (+7%) rise. Each port has only 20–46 shipments in Q2, so these percentages are noisy.
3. **`q2_dip_by_carrier_type`** is the same measure by carrier type. Tanker falls 15%, container 14% and bulk 4%. Container loses the most shipments by far: 4.2 a month, against 1.1 for tanker and 0.5 for bulk.

The two dip views share a helper cell, `q2_change_by`. It divides each group's Q2 count by 6 months and its other count by 18, so a month with no shipments for a port still counts. I also added an `altair` import for the bar charts.

The facts cells give only the numbers and don't say whether any hypothesis held. When you've looked at the charts, give me your verdict on each and I'll add it to its facts cell in your words.

import polars as pl
pl.Config.set_tbl_rows(40)
s=pl.scan_csv('data/shipments.csv',try_parse_dates=True)
m=s.group_by(pl.col('ship_date').dt.truncate('1mo').alias('month')).agg(pl.len().alias('shipments')).sort('month').collect()
print(m)
def dip(g):
    return (s.with_columns(pl.col('ship_date').dt.month().is_between(4,6).alias('q2'))
      .group_by(g,'q2').agg(pl.len().truediv(pl.col('ship_date').dt.truncate('1mo').n_unique()).alias('per_month'))
      .collect().pivot(on='q2',index=g,values='per_month')
      .rename({'true':'q2_per_month','false':'rest_per_month'})
      .with_columns(pl.col('q2_per_month').truediv(pl.col('rest_per_month')).sub(1).alias('q2_change'))
      .sort('q2_change'))
print(dip('port')); print(dip('carrier_type'))
"
